text: こうかん　したくなったら　また　くるのじゃ

structure.jp: こうかん　したくなったら
structure.en: when you come to want to exchange

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい means 'want to do'. Changed to たく and followed by なる it means 'come to want to do'. したくなった = 'came to want to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: The たら ending means 'if' or 'when' that happens. したくなったら = 'when you feel like doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man のだ. After a plain action word it can be a firm instruction to the listener. また　くるのじゃ = 'you come again'.
